show.description: Naman Ahuja, a haunted ex-elite operative, is pulled back into danger when he learns he has a daughter with powerful CEO Soma Arya. As rival business empires clash and enemies close in, Naman is forced into a reluctant marriage to protect them. Secrets resurface, loyalties are tested, and a fragile family forms amid a storm of power, betrayal, and survival.
